outline:
IBM PC組合語言範例練習，C語言範例練習，LED與開關之應用，點矩陣LED控制，鍵盤與螢幕之控制，計時器與計數器之應用，串列I/O介面，並列I/O介面。
LCD模組之控制，步進馬達之控制，高功率介面之控制與應用，DAC與ADC之控制應用，視時排訂。
schedule:
1-2, Introduction and overview, environment setup.
3, FDD, HDD, Filesystem
4-5, IA-32 instructions, IBM PC ASM
6-7, C Language, Inline ASM in C, ASM calls C, C calls ASM
7, I/O,interrupt, LED, LED arrays
8, Timer and music
9, BIOS and DOS service routines
10, Console Controlling (monitor and keyboard )
11, PIO, SIO
12, PCI and USB
assessment:
期中考 25%
期末考 25%
作業成果 50%
